biggest_catch: Real-world pay for basic tasks is roughly $2-$3/hr and training is unpaid; high per-hour claims require advanced (lidar) skills plus scarce task supply, and payments only arrive weekly.
catches: Basic image-annotation tasks pay on the order of $0.02-$0.10 per task; typical new-worker effective pay is about $2-$3/hr — very low for the time.
Training courses and bootcamps are free but UNPAID (bootcamp ~10-14 days) and you must pass accuracy assessments to unlock paid tasks.
Accuracy gates pay: work below quality thresholds can be rejected; account tiers (Attempter > Reviewer > Super Reviewer) control task access and pay.
Task supply is competitive and intermittent; most workers never reach the advertised 'up to $18/hr' or '$720/week'.
Must be 18+; laptop + stable internet required for most tasks.

steps: Create a free account at remotasks.com.
Complete the free (unpaid) training courses for your chosen task category and pass the accuracy assessment.
Access paid tasks on your dashboard (image annotation, lidar, NLP labeling, transcription) — pay per task, varies by difficulty.
Add your PayPal/AirTM email on the Account Page before the Tuesday 12:00 AM UTC cutoff.
Get paid automatically every Wednesday morning (no minimum payout).
timing: Weekly payout every Wednesday morning (9:00 AM-12:00 PM UTC) via PayPal or AirTM; pay period Wed-Tue with Tuesday 12:00 AM UTC cutoff; no minimum payout.
who_pays: Remotasks (Scale AI) pays you per completed task.
who_qualifies: 18+, in one of 90+ supported countries. Most tasks need a laptop and stable internet.
work_available: Competitive and intermittent — task supply is not steady, and your account tier (Attempter → Reviewer → Super Reviewer) controls which tasks you can even see.
what_gets_accepted: Tasks must meet accuracy thresholds; work below the quality bar can be rejected with no pay. You must pass unpaid training courses and bootcamps (about 10–14 days) plus accuracy assessments before any paid tasks unlock.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees — training and bootcamps are free but unpaid (roughly 10–14 days). Unpaid time: training, accuracy assessments, and waiting on scarce task supply.
when_cash_arrives: Weekly, every Wednesday morning (9:00 AM–12:00 PM UTC) via PayPal or AirTM. The pay period runs Wednesday–Tuesday, and there's no minimum payout.

repeatable.cadence: New tasks post regularly — complete tasks, get paid every Wednesday via PayPal, and keep going.
